verdict.rationale: Token2 makes FIDO2/PIV security keys and their management utilities (companion apps, the fido2-manage CLI/GUI, and Entra ID enrollment scripts). It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and use external tools, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
